```gherkin
Feature: User Authentication and System Administration

  Scenario: Valid User Login
    Given a valid username and password
    When the user attempts to login
    Then the user is redirected to the Virtual Clinic Main Menu

  Scenario: Invalid User Login
    Given an invalid username and password
    When the user attempts to login
    Then an error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials

  Scenario: Administrator Login
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator attempts to login
    Then the administrator is redirected to the System Administrator Screens

  Scenario: Maintain Speciality
    Given a valid speciality id, name, and description
    When the administrator attempts to add a speciality
    Then the speciality is added to the system

  Scenario: Edit/Update Speciality
    Given a valid speciality id, name, and description
    When the administrator attempts to edit a speciality
    Then the speciality is updated in the system

  Scenario Outline: Add Speciality Screen
    Given a speciality id, name, and description
    When the administrator attempts to add a speciality with the following details
      | id | name | description |
      | ${id} | ${name} | ${description} |
    Then the speciality is added to the system

  Examples:
    | id | name | description |
    | 1  | Cardiology | Heart-related conditions |
    | 2  | Neurology  | Brain-related conditions |
    | 3  | Invalid    | Invalid speciality name |

  Scenario Outline: Edit/Update Speciality Screen
    Given a speciality id, name, and description
    When the administrator attempts to edit a speciality with the following details
      | id | name | description |
      | ${id} | ${name} | ${description} |
    Then the speciality is updated in the system

  Examples:
    | id | name | description |
    | 1  | Cardiology | Heart-related conditions |
    | 2  | Neurology  | Brain-related conditions |
    | 3  | Invalid    | Invalid speciality name |

  Scenario: Administrator System Administrator Screens
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator accesses the System Administrator Screens
    Then the administrator can perform the following actions
      | action | description |
      | Set-up Users/ Passwords | Manage user accounts |
      | Set-up Control File (for Pincode) | Configure pincode settings |
      | Create Appointment File | Schedule appointments |
      | View/ Print Invoice | View and print invoices |
      | Back-ups | Create backups |
      | Archive Patient Profiles | Archive patient profiles |

  Scenario: Create Users
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator creates a new user
    Then the user is added to the system

  Scenario Outline: Maintain Chemists and Labs
    Given a valid chemist/lab id, name, and description
    When the administrator attempts to add a chemist/lab with the following details
      | id | name | description |
      | ${id} | ${name} | ${description} |
    Then the chemist/lab is added to the system

  Examples:
    | id | name | description |
    | 1  | XYZ Chemist | A chemist |
    | 2  | ABC Lab    | A lab    |
    | 3  | Invalid    | Invalid chemist/lab name |

  Scenario Outline: Edit/Update Chemists and Labs
    Given a valid chemist/lab id, name, and description
    When the administrator attempts to edit a chemist/lab with the following details
      | id | name | description |
      | ${id} | ${name} | ${description} |
    Then the chemist/lab is updated in the system

  Examples:
    | id | name | description |
    | 1  | XYZ Chemist | A chemist |
    | 2  | ABC Lab    | A lab    |
    | 3  | Invalid    | Invalid chemist/lab name |
```
